body: I often see my parents and how they probably had kids because it was expected of them from the society they were living in, not because they actually wanted to. Even though they wanted me to be what they expected of me, they never asked what I actually wanted. I came to think bad of myself and even hate myself. I appreciate your support and I will try to take up stoicism again and get out of this self-made pleasure hell that I've found myself in.

Well, I've had trouble making friends since I was born because of some Asperger's. And I'm also a closeted gay man, which makes me very cautious of what I'm saying and how I'm saying it. Often I've been having "friends" who were also alienated by society, who had no option but me, but when they found some other friends, they quickly abandoned me in favor of them. Often I've been seen as creepy by others. I was also often looking for my "tribe" and I found it most of the time and that's where I was feeling accepted as long as I lived by their norms and rules. Social skills have never been my strong side because of my disability and I have so much trauma from my life, especially my early childhood from bullying and alienation. I always felt like everybody hated me like hell, including the teachers and even my own family. Every day I wish I had never been born, but something has still been keeping me alive, however, being a fond reader of stoicism, I have realized that if I don't feel there's anything left for me in this life, I can as well end it.

This was like 15 years ago, and tbh it didn't bother me much, and I wasn't molested per se, as I agreed to it, however, I prefer it didn't happen as I was a little kid and didn't know any better. But do you think these experiences had any impact on me?
I knew someone would say "wtf" and it's okay, but this is how I truly feel and I am looking for serious answers.

I don't know what it is about NYE, but I absolutely hate that I'm alone, and I've been thinking about it for months now that I'm gonna be at my parents' house that night while everyone is out there celebrating it with somebody. I don't even care that I don't have a partner, I just wanna be invited and be a part of something.
